capabilities: Draft articles from vault notes with evidence-bound knowledge and claims
Run a gated distill-research-draft-critique pipeline stored as Markdown
Generate and revise text via Codex or Claude CLIs
Review evidence chains and diffs, then approve or reject drafts
Export approved articles and prepare WeChat official-account drafts
disambiguation: Not a one-click publisher; the plugin does not automatically approve or publicly publish articles, and exports require explicit author approval.
extras: Windows-only verification (Obsidian 1.13.7 desktop); the community download ships only main.js/manifest.json/styles.css, so the Python kernel, dependencies, and CLI setup must be installed manually; three Windows symlink permission test failures remain; privacy and third-party notices live in external PRIVACY.md and NOTICE.md.
problem: Obsidian has no structured workflow for developing notes into finished articles with evidence-bound claims, review records, and an explicit human approval gate.
